issue.title: [Bug] Git commit subjects containing a pipe character are truncated

steps: Initialize a Git repository, configure user.name Fixture and user.email fixture@example.com, create note.txt containing hello, and commit it with the exact subject alpha | beta. Use git_log to show the commit and quote its full subject.
expected: The full commit subject alpha | beta survives parsing and display.
defect: The subject is truncated at the pipe because a delimiter-based parser splits user-controlled commit text.

fault location.explanation: The git history helper uses pipe-delimited log fields and destructures a split row without preserving additional pipe characters in the subject. This is a parsing-boundary issue, not Git truncating the stored commit.

Root cause: The git history helper uses pipe-delimited log fields and destructures a split row without preserving additional pipe characters in the subject. This is a parsing-boundary issue, not Git truncating the stored commit.
